meta.description: A per-minute rate limit answered with 429 and Retry-After (gateway error shape), then success on the retry.
meta.source: docs/vendor/token-factory.md: 'A limited request returns 429 with Retry-After (60 s for per-minute limits, 1 s for concurrency)'; gateway errors use the OpenAI shape {"error":{...}}. Retry-After is 1 here so the test's recorded delay is short; the sleep is not real in tests.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded: too many concurrent requests
